cohort: The study included 108 mothers of children aged 3-10 years, divided into 54 mothers of children diagnosed with ASD (cases) and 54 mothers of neurotypical children (controls).
finding: Neonatal complications, particularly delayed birth cry and NICU admission, were significantly associated with Autism Spectrum Disorder.
mod_finding: Cesarean section deliveries were more common among mothers of children with ASD (55.6%) compared to mothers of neurotypical children (40.7%).
